title: Lincoln cent, Union Shield reverse (2010-present)
notes: Circulation pennies were last struck for commerce in 2025.

title: Lincoln cent, Memorial reverse (1959-2008)
notes: 1982 cents exist in both bronze (3.11 g) and zinc (2.5 g); weighing tells them apart.

title: Lincoln cent, Wheat reverse (1909-1958)
notes: Key dates include 1909-S VDB, 1909-S, 1914-D, 1922 (no D) and 1931-S. 1943 cents are zinc-coated steel.

title: Lincoln cent, 1943 zinc-coated steel
notes: Silvery color and attracted to a magnet. A copper-colored 1943 cent is either a rare error or plated; have it authenticated.

title: Jefferson nickel, forward-facing portrait (2006-present)
notes: The Monticello reverse is also used on 1938-2003 nickels, which have a left-facing profile.

title: Jefferson nickel, profile portrait (1938-2004)
notes: 1942-1945 'war nickels' with a large mint mark above Monticello contain 35% silver (0.0563 troy oz).

title: Westward Journey nickel: Ocean in View (2005)
Buffalo nickel, Type 2 'line' reverse (1913-1938)
notes: Dates wear off easily. Key coins include 1913-S Type 2, 1916 doubled die, 1918/7-D, 1921-S, 1926-S and 1937-D three-legged.

title: Buffalo nickel, Type 1 'mound' reverse (1913)
notes: The bison stands on a raised mound; on Type 2 it stands on a flat line with 'FIVE CENTS' recessed below.

title: Roosevelt dime (1946-present)
notes: Dimes dated 1964 and earlier are 90% silver (0.0723 troy oz); 1965 and later are copper-nickel clad.

title: Winged Liberty Head ('Mercury') dime (1916-1945)
notes: Key dates include 1916-D, 1921 and 1921-D. Full split bands on the reverse fasces add value.
